response.overview: The Cure performed an extra, historic opening day at the Pohoda Festival on Wednesday, July 8, 2026, marking their very first-ever live concert in Slovakia. Added as a special 4th day for the festival's 30th anniversary, opened with "Alone," followed by classics like "Pictures of You," "Lovesong," "A Forest," and "Endsong"  Finished a massive encore block featuring "Lullaby," "Friday I'm in Love," and a closing rendition of "Boys Don't Cry"
response.title: The Cure - Pohoda Festival 2026
